summary: Biodexa Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 6-K disclosing a registered direct offering and concurrent private placements. On June 29, 2026, the company entered a securities purchase agreement with an institutional investor to issue 82,809 ADSs at $2.85/ADS and 200,143 pre-funded warrants at $2.8499/ADS (exercise price $0.0001). A first private placement includes Series M warrants for 282,952 ADSs exercisable at $2.85/ADS, subject to shareholder approval and beneficial ownership limits of 4.99% or 9.99%. The offering uses an existing Form F-3 shelf registration. This is a capital raise, not a special situation like restructuring or going-private. Watch for shareholder vote and warrant exercise dynamics.
